field.label: Mode at registration
field.help: Learning detects and reports but blocks nothing: start with it, then switch to Full protection from the Status tab or the dashboard.

field.label: Block on interfaces
field.help: Inbound traffic from InfraFence's banned, threat-feed and country addresses is blocked on these interfaces (WAN by default).

field.label: Block LAN to banned
field.help: Also stop LAN hosts from reaching banned and threat-feed addresses (command-and-control servers).
